title: VHF Lower Blade Antenna — Installation
abstract: Installation of a lower blade antenna on the fuselage antenna land, with the land preparation, the wet installation of the fasteners, the bonding check and the standing wave measurement that closes the task.

sections.purpose: To install a lower blade antenna on the fuselage antenna land and to prove the installation by bonding measurement and by a standing wave ratio check.
sections.job_setup_note: The antenna land must be prepared and treated within the application window of the sealant system in use, which is ninety minutes for the chromate-free system. The fasteners are installed wet and the bonding check must be made before the sealant cures. External power and the radio test set are needed. Two persons are needed.
sections.procedure: Make sure that the electrical power is removed and that the circuit breaker for the set is collared. Remove the protective blank from the land. Clean the land with the approved solvent and let it dry. Abrade the land to bare metal at the bonding positions only and remove the residue. CAUTION: ABRADE ONLY THE BONDING POSITIONS. ABRADING THE WHOLE LAND REMOVES THE PROTECTIVE TREATMENT FROM AN AREA THAT WILL NOT BE RE-SEALED. Apply the surface treatment to the standard practice and observe the application window. Connect the coaxial connector to the antenna and lock it. Apply sealant to the antenna base sealing face. Put the antenna module D2320128501183 on the land and align it with the fore and aft datum. Install the screws AGS216702-16 with washers EN561587K4 wet with sealant, working from the centre outwards, and torque to 3.5 Nm. Wipe the extruded sealant and form the fillet around the base. Measure the bonding resistance between the antenna base and the airframe before the sealant cures and make sure that the value is below the limit. Restore the electrical power and remove the collar from the circuit breaker. WARNING: MAKE SURE THAT NO PERSON IS WITHIN TWO METRES OF THE ANTENNA BEFORE THE SET IS KEYED. Connect the radio test set and measure the standing wave ratio at three frequencies across the band. Record the three values and make sure that each is inside the limit.
sections.close_out: Let the sealant cure for the time in the table before the aircraft is moved or washed. Remove the radio test set and the working platform. Make sure that the fillet is continuous and that no drain path is blocked. Remove the safety barriers. Record the installation, the antenna part number, the bonding value, the three standing wave ratio values and the sealant system used.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. The ground plane skirt seals against bare metal on aircraft post MOD-111925.

safety_precautions: Make sure that no person is within two metres of the antenna before the set is keyed.
Observe the sealant application window after abrasion.

tooling.description: Nylon scraper and wedge set, antenna
Radio test set, standing wave ratio
